description: Tell the maintainer what is wrong, what is missing, or what worked well (a wrong text, a missing amendment, a broken answer, or that this server helped you). One-way: no reply is sent.

category.description: error = something factually wrong; content_gap = correct request for missing material; useful = this server helped - say what worked; other = anything else

message.description: What is wrong, missing, or helpful. Max 1,000 characters.

tool.description: Optional: which tool the feedback is about

name: send_feedback
